name: Mahjong for a Cause
description: Charity mahjong in Friendswood (Hall's Hall) with open play, Mahjong 101 lessons and leagues; proceeds go to local nonprofits. Official page: "Complete all 72 hands on the 2026 NMJL Card" (A League of Your Own). Open to the public; 'Request a Lesson' offered.
schedule: Open play several times weekly (e.g. $15 per session; Wed $10); Mahjong 101 lessons $40
